name: Weather forecast (portrait)
description: Current conditions and a five-day forecast from one of your Weather data sources. Your server fetches the weather itself; the template only lays it out. Portrait 9:16 layout.
author: ScreenTinker

params.name: weather
params.label: Weather data source
params.help: A data source of type Weather (Data Sources → New → Weather). Its location, units and language are set there.

params.name: location
params.label: Location name
params.help: The heading. Usually the city or the site's name.

params.name: units_label
params.label: Temperature suffix
params.help: Shown after every temperature: ° on its own, or °C / °F to match the data source.

params.name: today_label
params.label: Today label
params.help: Shown before today's high and low.

params.name: precip_label
params.label: Precipitation label
params.help: Shown before today's chance of precipitation.

params.name: updated_label
params.label: Updated label
params.help: Shown before the time of the last reading.

params.name: timezone
params.label: Clock timezone
params.help: Leave empty to use the screen's own clock.

params.name: locale
params.label: Language
params.help: The language of the date, e.g. de or fr-CA. Leave empty for the screen's language. Forecast day names and the condition come from the data source.
